violation_type.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))
violation_type.short_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For
violation_type.typical_finding: This standard was evaluated in regard to an investigation and a violation was found. The operation did not know who they were responsible to pick up  on the day of the incident. As a result, the operation failed to pick up two children from elementary school.

finding_variants.text: This standard was evaluated in regard to an investigation and a violation was found. The operation did not know who they were responsible to pick up  on the day of the incident. As a result, the operation failed to pick up two children from elementary school.
One caregiver had to count the number of children in care, and was not sure of the exact ages of the children.
One caregiver was unaware of the number of children in the classroom.
Caregivers did not know the total number of children in the classroom during the follow up inspection.
The caregiver in room #6 did not know the number of children in her care. The caregiver stated there were 8 children in care and I counted 9 children.

A teacher responsible for the 5y to 6y olds was unaware of the number of children currently present. The teacher stated there were 8 children present but there were 9 children currently present in the classroom.
